Diese Möglichkeit besteht unabhängig von der Rechtsna- tur der zwischen dem Bewerber und den anderen Unternehmen bestehenden Verbindun- gen. In diesem Fall ist der Vergabestelle nachzuweisen, dass dem Bewerber die erforderli- chen Mittel tatsächlich zur Verfügung stehen werden, indem beispielsweise eine entspre- chende Verpflichtungserklärung dieses Unternehmens vorgelegt wird. Die Unternehmen, auf die sich ein Bewerber zum Nachweis seiner Eignung stützt, müssen die Eignung hinsichtlich derjenigen Eignungskriterien erfüllen, zu deren Nachweis sich der Bewerber auf die Eignung des Unternehmens stützt. Zudem sind die Erklärungen über das Vorliegen von Ausschlussgründen nach § 123 Abs. 1 bis 4 GWB und § 124 Abs. 1 GWB auch für diese Unternehmen vorzulegen. Werden die vorstehend dargestellten Eignungs- anforderungen nicht erfüllt oder liegen Ausschlussgründe gemäß § 123 Abs. 1 bis 4 GWB vor, so ist das Unternehmen auf Aufforderung der Vergabestelle innerhalb einer von dieser vorgegeb

The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. All hazards shall be eliminated or reduced to the lowest risk level practical using methods in the following order of precedence: design; incorporation of safety devices; incorporation of warning devices; technical manual procedures; and New Equipment Training (NET) and sustainment training. Catastrophic and critical hazards (as defined in MIL-STD-882) shall not rely solely on warnings, cautions, or procedures/training for control of risk. Electrical Safety Electrical materials and equipment shall be selected, applied, installed and protected in accordance with NFPA 70. Where COTS equipment is used, the contractor shall select equipment that has been listed or certified by a Nationally Recognized Test Laboratory such as UL. The listing or certification shall cover the intended equipment usage and operating environment. Operators shall not be exposed to components with voltages exceeding 30 volts (V). thout explicit Government approval. Exposed and under-floor wires and cables in the EEB shall be of the low smoke zero halogen (LSZH) type. This requirement is not applicable to the internal wiring of equipment racks, LRIs and DLRIs. Additional Safety Provisions Audible and visual warning devices shall be provided to indicate malfunctions and hazardous conditions that could cause injury and/or equipment damage. Audible warning signals shall be distinguishable from other sounds under normal operating conditions. Visual signals shall be readily visible and easily recognized. Colors of safety critical controls and indicators shall be yellow for caution and red for danger. Any color is permitted for functional controls or indicators, provided it is clear that safety is not involved. Safety warnings for proper operation and maintenance of all subsystems utilizing lasers shall be included in the technical manual. ip_data_security.text: nboarding the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) to the National Eye Institute’s (NEI) existing OpenSpecimen biobanking software instance and implementing associated Electronic Medical Record (EMR) integration services. Competition is restricted to Krishagni LLC because NHLBI’s requirement is specifically to onboard to NEI’s active, Krishagni-licensed and operated OpenSpecimen environment rather than to procure a separate standalone biobanking system. Acquiring a different biobanking product would not satisfy the requirement to join the existing NEI shared instance and would result in substantial duplication of software licensing, implementation, validation, and support infrastructure costs, as well as unacceptable operational delays. As the software developer, proprietor, and operator of the existing NEI OpenSpecimen environment, Krishagni LLC is the only responsible source authorized and technically capable of performing the required onboarding, workflow configuration, and EMR integration services within that shared platform.
